name: Flames of Darkness
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (an agate of at least 10 gp value)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell causes the object touched to produce flames of darkness that encircle the object in a 20-foot radius. These flames do not produce heat nor use oxygen. Anyone within the radius gains darkvision within the area of effect only.
